name: SolverRefusal
message:
solverBot(c1) chest (880,816) stance: the combat ladder is EXHAUSTED. The corridor passes through danger at (743.6,851.7) — chaser:bob@736,752 (inside leash 80 (d=3.0), box grown 0.5 px/tick x 0 + pad 0) — and every rung of ⚖ §11.8a's order refused:
  avoid: no admissible corridor with the danger map's 17 volume(s) forbidden — A* goal tile (55,52) in level 40 — for (888,834) — is not walkable: danger:bobsoldier@880,832 (a stepped bobsoldier at its LIVE position) at (868,822). The planner works in whole tiles, so both ends o
  time: the aim is 222 px away and `mover.MOVER_RANGE` measures this search reaching 48 px as an UPPER BOUND at dwell 4. TIME is the contested LAST-MILE tool (kickoff §3.1); it is not a room-crossing one, and the bound is named rather than widened.
  bait: NO LIVE BODY's removal admits a corridor — the danger on this corridor is [chaser:bob@736,752] and this room's live roster is [bob@320,112, bob@288,112, bob@288,80, bob@304,144, bob@272,112, bobsoldier@880,832, bob@736,752, bob@736,800, bob@192,480, bob@352,448, bob@352,416, bob@208,448, bob@224,496, puncher@128,624, puncher@816,128]. A bait moves a body along its own straight line; a static census body, a hazard volume and an arrow lane do not have one, and a body whose removal changes no corridor is not what is in the way.
  kill: the danger on this corridor is not a body this run can watch die — a kill needs a target whose removal the model OBSERVES (a live chaser or spinner the run steps; a live body without a recorded removal is not a target), and ⛔ a static "Enemy" body's own arrow death is REFUSED by name (§11.4): its clear is the tape's DECLARED v9 `at` row, and a second writer of one persistence slot is two cost models. (F4: the classes whose death the run computes, [SandTrap], are targets of the static arm, not of this one.)
  detour: deadline — the caller's anytime deadline (`shouldStop`) was reached before the DETOUR search, so it was not run ⏱ DEADLINE: the caller's `shouldStop` tripped (first at `detour`) and refused 1 `detour` scan(s) — this refusal may be the deadline's, not the room's.
